_comment: qou's folio configuration. This file is `folio.config.json` renamed: the platform stopped reading the old name on 2026-09-18 and it is NOT a fallback — `resolveHarnessConfigPath` in folio-assistant's schemas/harness-config.ts reads `harness.config.json` and nothing else, so a folio still carrying the old name is UNCONFIGURED rather than half-configured. Nothing warns about it; the symptom is `profile-check.ts` reporting `undetermined` and running every criterion, including the paper adapter's LaTeX-shaped axes. Distinct from `harness.json`, which is the directory DECLARATION (where the folio tree is — here `content/`); this file is what the folio IS.
_adapterModule_comment: Kept from folio.config.json and verified to resolve: `<qou>/folio-assistant/adapters/paper/index.ts`. It is redundant with `contentType: "paper"` — `BUILTIN_ADAPTERS` in the platform's src/builtin-adapters.ts names the same module — and the builtin path is the better one, because it SAYS out loud when the science layer is absent and it falls back, where a dead `adapterModule` only logs a load failure. Left in place because this migration renames a file rather than redesigning it; dropping the line is a one-line follow-up.
_qaAxes_comment: The opt-in for THIS folio's mathematics. folio-assistant fenced the `framework`, `wall` and `detangler-archimedean-wall` criteria behind this axis in #523, because they encode one folio's mathematics rather than a platform concern — `folioOptionalAxes()` in content/pipeline/qa-criteria-registry.ts reads this key and registers none of them when it is absent. This key did NOT arrive with the folio.config.json rename, so all six criteria have been unregistered since: `framework-canonical`, `wall-side-correct`, `wall-side-statement`, `wall-side-proof`, `wall-base-ring-minimal` and `detangler-archimedean-wall`, together with the matching watcher buckets, which are gated on the same axis so a bucket cannot name a criterion the registry never registered. The COMPUTATION was not entirely lost — q-usage-audit.ts calls checkWallSide and checkBaseRingMinimal directly — but the registered criteria were, so there are no QA sidecar verdicts for any of the six and nothing reported their absence. ONE axis name opens all six deliberately: the platform comment is explicit that it is one wall, so a folio opens both halves with one key and cannot end up half-fenced. NOTE `q-usage` is a SEPARATE axis gating seven more criteria and is deliberately not listed here — that is its own decision.
_feedbackDir_comment: CHANGED from `folio-assistant/feedback`, which is the one value that did not survive the rename. That path does not exist under either layout, and `feedbackDir` is resolved against the FOLIO root, so the old value pointed the feedback store inside the platform checkout — a directory `FeedbackStore` would have created on first write, in a submodule/symlink qou does not own. No data moves: qou has no feedback store on disk today. `.folio-feedback` is the platform default and what `folio_init` writes.

viewer._comment: `port` is read (src/index.ts -> FolioServer.viewerPort). `dir` currently is not read by anything — kept because it is the documented shape in harness.config.example.json and it does resolve.

simulators._comment: The FOLIO's own directory — simulators are subject matter, so this path is relative to the qou root, not the platform.
